map.量化压缩比估算器，输入模型量化前后精度(如 FP32→INT8)估算参数量与显存: The quantization compression ratio estimator takes the precision before and after quantization (such as FP32 -> INT8) to estimate the compression ratio for parameter count and memory footprint, supporting on-device deployment optimization.
map.压缩比 = 原位数 / 目标位数；模型大小(MB) ≈ 参数量 × 位数 / 8: Compression ratio = original bits / target bits; model size (MB) is about parameter count x bits / 8 / 1024^2
map.量化通过降低权重数值精度（FP32→INT8 即 4:1）直接缩小体积与带宽需求: Quantization lowers the numeric precision of weights (FP32 -> INT8 gives 4:1), directly shrinking model size and bandwidth needs, which clearly pays off in compute-constrained settings. But the accuracy loss shows up in the metrics, so models sensitive to outliers need quantization-aware training or per-channel calibration.
map.压缩比=量化前位数/量化后位数，如 FP32(32bit)→INT8(8bit): Compression ratio = bits before quantization / bits after quantization; for example FP32 (32 bit) -> INT8 (8 bit) compresses 4x in theory.
map.实际显存节省还需扣减反量化层与激活的精度开销，常略低于理论值。: Real memory savings must also deduct the overhead of dequantization layers and activations, so they are usually slightly below the theoretical figure.
map.量化分训练后(PTQ)与量化感知训练(QAT)，后者精度损失更小。: Quantization comes as post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT); the latter loses less accuracy.
map.：7B 模型 FP16 权重≈14GB，量化 INT8≈3.5GB(约 4× 压: FP16 weights of a 7B model are about 14GB; quantized to INT8 about 3.5GB (roughly 4x compression), deployable on a consumer GPU; going further to INT4 gives about 1.75GB but noticeably larger accuracy loss, so acceptability must be measured.
map.会损失一定精度，但 PTQ+校准或 QAT 可把损失压到很小；小模型/低比特(I: Some accuracy is lost, but PTQ plus calibration or QAT can keep the loss very small; small models and low bit widths (INT4) lose more, so validate with downstream task metrics.
map.压缩比和推理速度是一回事？: Is Compression Ratio the Same Thing as Inference Speed?
map.相关但不等价。低比特省显存、提升访存带宽利用率，常提速；但是否真正加速还取决于硬: Related but not equivalent. Low bit widths save memory and improve bandwidth utilization, so they usually speed things up; whether it is a real speedup still depends on hardware support for low-bit kernels and dequantization.
